```{ojs}
catData = FileAttachment("data/catalogue.json").json()
strataAll = catData.strata
studiesAll = catData.studies
cohortsAll = catData.cohort_membership
protSummary = catData.protein_summary
protIndex = catData.proteins_index
meta = catData.metadata
```

```{ojs}
// Pre-compute Catalogue KPI metrics & 2-panel summary figure series from active (non-superseded) records
catSummary = {
  const activeStudies = studiesAll.filter(s => s.status !== "Superseded Preprint");
  const activeStudyIds = new Set(activeStudies.map(s => s.study_id));
  const activeStrata = strataAll.filter(s => s.status !== "Superseded Preprint");

  const nPublished = activeStudies.filter(s => s.status === "Published").length;
  const nPreprints = activeStudies.filter(s => s.status === "Preprint").length;

  const activeCohortsSet = new Set(
    cohortsAll.filter(c => activeStudyIds.has(c.study_id)).map(c => c.cohort)
  );

  const nGw = activeStrata.filter(s => s.data_label === "Genome-wide").length;
  const nGwOpen = activeStrata.filter(s => s.data_label === "Genome-wide" && s.access_short === "open").length;
  const nTopHits = activeStrata.filter(s => s.data_label === "Top-hits").length;
  const nCis = activeStrata.filter(s => s.data_label === "Gene-region").length;
  const nUnavail = activeStrata.filter(s => s.data_label === "Unavailable").length;

  const platOrder = ["Olink", "SomaScan", "Mass Spectrometry", "Luminex", "Other Immunoassay", "NULISA"];
  const platShort = {
    "Olink": "Olink",
    "SomaScan": "SomaScan",
    "Mass Spectrometry": "MS",
    "Luminex": "Luminex",
    "Other Immunoassay": "Other",
    "NULISA": "NULISA"
  };
  const platCounts = [];
  for (const p of platOrder) {
    const n = activeStrata.filter(s => s.platform_category === p).length;
    if (n > 0) platCounts.push({ label: platShort[p] || p, full: p, count: n });
  }
  platCounts.sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count);

  const years = activeStudies.map(s => Number(s.year)).filter(Number.isFinite);
  const minYear = years.length ? Math.min(...years) : 2008;
  const maxYear = years.length ? Math.max(...years) : 2026;
  const yearSeq = [];
  for (let y = minYear; y <= maxYear; y++) yearSeq.push(y);

  // Panel 1: Studies per year stacked by Status x Open Genome-Wide data availability
  const studyHasOpenGw = new Set(
    activeStrata
      .filter(s => s.data_label === "Genome-wide" && s.access_short === "open")
      .map(s => s.study_id)
  );
  const barCategories = [
    "Published · Open genome-wide",
    "Preprint · Open genome-wide",
    "Published · Other tier / access",
    "Preprint · Other tier / access"
  ];
  const barData = [];
  for (const y of yearSeq) {
    const inYr = activeStudies.filter(s => Number(s.year) === y);
    const counts = {
      "Published · Open genome-wide": 0,
      "Preprint · Open genome-wide": 0,
      "Published · Other tier / access": 0,
      "Preprint · Other tier / access": 0
    };
    for (const s of inYr) {
      const openGw = studyHasOpenGw.has(s.study_id);
      const isPub = s.status === "Published";
      if (isPub && openGw) counts["Published · Open genome-wide"] += 1;
      else if (!isPub && openGw) counts["Preprint · Open genome-wide"] += 1;
      else if (isPub) counts["Published · Other tier / access"] += 1;
      else counts["Preprint · Other tier / access"] += 1;
    }
    for (const cat of barCategories) {
      barData.push({
        year: y,
        category: cat,
        count: counts[cat],
        yearTotal: inYr.length,
        yearOpenGw: counts["Published · Open genome-wide"] + counts["Preprint · Open genome-wide"]
      });
    }
  }

  // Panel 2: Cumulative unique cohorts & cumulative POPULATION records over time
  const studyYearById = new Map(activeStudies.map(s => [s.study_id, Number(s.year)]));
  const popOrder = ["EUR", "MULTI", "AFR", "EAS", "CSA", "AMR", "MID"];
  const cumLines = [];

  for (const y of yearSeq) {
    const cohUpToY = new Set();
    for (const c of cohortsAll) {
      const sy = studyYearById.get(c.study_id);
      if (sy !== undefined && sy <= y) cohUpToY.add(c.cohort);
    }
    cumLines.push({
      year: y,
      series: "Unique cohorts",
      count: cohUpToY.size,
      isCohort: true
    });
    for (const pop of popOrder) {
      const nPop = activeStrata.filter(s => s.pop_super === pop && Number(s.year) <= y).length;
      cumLines.push({
        year: y,
        series: pop,
        count: nPop,
        isCohort: false
      });
    }
  }

  return {
    nStudies: activeStudies.length,
    nPublished,
    nPreprints,
    nStrata: activeStrata.length,
    nCohorts: activeCohortsSet.size,
    nProteins: protSummary.length,
    nAssayRecords: protIndex.length,
    nGw,
    nGwOpen,
    nRemaining: activeStrata.length - nGw,
    nTopHits,
    nCis,
    nUnavail,
    platCounts,
    minYear,
    maxYear,
    yearSeq,
    barCategories,
    barData,
    cumLines
  };
}
```

```{ojs}
// Full-width Catalogue view: 6 KPI boxes + 11-column filterable/paginated table + synced 2-row dropdown + 2-panel summary figure
{
  const state = {
    hideSuperseded: true,
    sortCol: "year",
    sortAsc: false,
    pageSize: 10,
    page: 1,
    expanded: new Set(),
    filters: {
      author: "",
      year: "",
      cohort: "",
      overlap: "",
      population: "",
      sex: "",
      n: "",
      sample: "",
      platform: "",
      assay: "",
      data: ""
    }
  };

  const countSpan = htl.html`<span></span>`;
  const pageInfoSpan = htl.html`<span></span>`;

  const clearBtn = htl.html`<button class="btn-pill" style="display:none;padding:0.2rem 0.55rem;font-size:0.74rem;" onclick=${() => {
    for (const k of Object.keys(state.filters)) state.filters[k] = "";
    for (const el of filterInputs) el.value = "";
    state.page = 1;
    renderRows();
  }}>✕ Clear filters</button>`;

  const pageSizeSelect = htl.html`<select class="col-filter-select" style="width:auto;min-width:68px;" onchange=${e => {
    state.pageSize = e.target.value === "all" ? Infinity : Number(e.target.value);
    state.page = 1;
    renderRows();
  }}>
    <option value="10" selected>10</option>
    <option value="20">20</option>
    <option value="50">50</option>
    <option value="all">All</option>
  </select>`;

  const prevBtn = htl.html`<button class="btn-pill" onclick=${() => {
    if (state.page > 1) {
      state.page -= 1;
      renderRows();
    }
  }}>← Previous</button>`;

  const nextBtn = htl.html`<button class="btn-pill" onclick=${() => {
    state.page += 1;
    renderRows();
  }}>Next →</button>`;

  const cols = [
    { key: "author",     label: "AUTHOR"     },
    { key: "year",       label: "YEAR"       },
    { key: "cohort",     label: "COHORT"     },
    { key: "overlap",    label: "OVERLAP"    },
    { key: "population", label: "POPULATION" },
    { key: "sex",        label: "SEX"        },
    { key: "n",          label: "N"          },
    { key: "sample",     label: "SAMPLE"     },
    { key: "platform",   label: "PLATFORM"   },
    { key: "assay",      label: "ASSAY"      },
    { key: "data",       label: "DATA"       }
  ];

  const sortIndicators = {};
  const sortHeaders = cols.map(col => {
    const ind = htl.html`<span style="opacity:0.55;margin-left:3px;font-size:0.68rem;">↕</span>`;
    sortIndicators[col.key] = ind;
    return htl.html`<th onclick=${() => {
      if (state.sortCol === col.key) {
        state.sortAsc = !state.sortAsc;
      } else {
        state.sortCol = col.key;
        state.sortAsc = ["year", "n", "assay", "overlap"].includes(col.key) ? false : true;
      }
      state.page = 1;
      renderRows();
    }}>${col.label}${ind}</th>`;
  });

  const filterInputs = [];
  const makeTextFilter = (key, placeholder) => {
    const inp = htl.html`<input class="col-filter-input" type="text" placeholder=${placeholder} oninput=${e => {
      state.filters[key] = e.target.value;
      state.page = 1;
      renderRows();
    }}>`;
    filterInputs.push(inp);
    return inp;
  };
  const makeSelectFilter = (key, options) => {
    const sel = htl.html`<select class="col-filter-select" onchange=${e => {
      state.filters[key] = e.target.value;
      state.page = 1;
      renderRows();
    }}>
      <option value="">All</option>
      ${options.map(o => htl.html`<option value=${o}>${o}</option>`)}
    </select>`;
    filterInputs.push(sel);
    return sel;
  };

  const filterRow = htl.html`<tr class="filter-row">
    <th>${makeTextFilter("author", "Author / PMID...")}</th>
    <th>${makeTextFilter("year", "e.g. 2023, >=2022")}</th>
    <th>${makeTextFilter("cohort", "UKB, INTERVAL...")}</th>
    <th>${makeTextFilter("overlap", "None, >0, ID...")}</th>
    <th>${makeSelectFilter("population", ["EUR", "AFR", "EAS", "CSA", "AMR", "MID", "MULTI"])}</th>
    <th>${makeSelectFilter("sex", ["Combined", "Female", "Male"])}</th>
    <th>${makeTextFilter("n", ">=5000")}</th>
    <th>${makeTextFilter("sample", "Plasma, serum...")}</th>
    <th>${makeTextFilter("platform", "SomaScan, Olink...")}</th>
    <th>${makeTextFilter("assay", ">=1000")}</th>
    <th>${makeSelectFilter("data", ["Genome-wide", "Gene-region", "Top-hits", "Unavailable"])}</th>
  </tr>`;

  const tbody = htl.html`<tbody></tbody>`;

  function getFilteredAndSorted() {
    const f = state.filters;
    const rows = strataAll.filter(d => {
      if (state.hideSuperseded && d.status === "Superseded Preprint") return false;
      if (f.author) {
        const q = f.author.toLowerCase();
        if (!`${d.first_author} ${d.pmid || ""} ${d.doi || ""} ${d.study_id}`.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return false;
      }
      if (f.year && !matchNumericFilter(d.year, f.year)) return false;
      if (f.cohort && !d.cohorts_display.toLowerCase().includes(f.cohort.toLowerCase())) return false;
      if (f.overlap) {
        const q = f.overlap.trim().toLowerCase();
        if (q === ">0" || q === "yes") {
          if (d.overlap_count === 0) return false;
        } else if (!`${d.overlap_compact} ${d.overlap_ids}`.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return false;
      }
      if (f.population && d.pop_super !== f.population) return false;
      if (f.sex && d.sex !== f.sex) return false;
      if (f.n && !matchNumericFilter(d.n_samples, f.n)) return false;
      if (f.sample && !d.sample_matrix.toLowerCase().includes(f.sample.toLowerCase())) return false;
      if (f.platform && !`${d.platform_category} ${d.platform_version}`.toLowerCase().includes(f.platform.toLowerCase())) return false;
      if (f.assay && !matchNumericFilter(d.n_assays, f.assay)) return false;
      if (f.data && d.data_label !== f.data) return false;
      return true;
    });

    const dir = state.sortAsc ? 1 : -1;
    rows.sort((a, b) => {
      switch (state.sortCol) {
        case "author":     return dir * (a.first_author.localeCompare(b.first_author) || (b.year - a.year));
        case "year":       return dir * ((a.year - b.year) || (a.n_samples - b.n_samples));
        case "cohort":     return dir * a.cohorts_display.localeCompare(b.cohorts_display);
        case "overlap":    return dir * (a.overlap_count - b.overlap_count);
        case "population": return dir * a.pop_super.localeCompare(b.pop_super);
        case "sex":        return dir * a.sex.localeCompare(b.sex);
        case "n":          return dir * (a.n_samples - b.n_samples);
        case "sample":     return dir * a.sample_matrix.localeCompare(b.sample_matrix);
        case "platform":   return dir * a.platform_version.localeCompare(b.platform_version);
        case "assay":      return dir * (a.n_assays - b.n_assays);
        case "data":       return dir * a.data_label.localeCompare(b.data_label);
        default:           return dir * (a.year - b.year);
      }
    });
    return rows;
  }

  function renderRows() {
    for (const c of cols) {
      const ind = sortIndicators[c.key];
      if (state.sortCol === c.key) {
        ind.textContent = state.sortAsc ? " ↑" : " ↓";
        ind.style.opacity = "1";
      } else {
        ind.textContent = " ↕";
        ind.style.opacity = "0.45";
      }
    }

    const anyFilter = Object.values(state.filters).some(v => v && v.trim() !== "");
    clearBtn.style.display = anyFilter ? "inline-flex" : "none";

    const allRows = getFilteredAndSorted();
    const total = allRows.length;
    const totalPages = state.pageSize === Infinity ? 1 : Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / state.pageSize));
    if (state.page > totalPages) state.page = totalPages;

    const startIdx = state.pageSize === Infinity ? 0 : (state.page - 1) * state.pageSize;
    const endIdx   = state.pageSize === Infinity ? total : Math.min(total, startIdx + state.pageSize);
    const pageRows = allRows.slice(startIdx, endIdx);

    countSpan.textContent = total === 0
      ? "0 matching records"
      : `Showing ${startIdx + 1}–${endIdx} of ${total} records · Click any row to expand`;
    pageInfoSpan.textContent = `Page ${state.page} of ${totalPages}`;
    prevBtn.disabled = state.page <= 1;
    nextBtn.disabled = state.page >= totalPages;

    const trs = [];
    for (const d of pageRows) {
      const isOpen = state.expanded.has(d.stratum_id);
      const toggle = () => {
        if (state.expanded.has(d.stratum_id)) state.expanded.delete(d.stratum_id);
        else state.expanded.add(d.stratum_id);
        renderRows();
      };

      trs.push(htl.html`<tr class="data-row ${isOpen ? "is-open" : ""}" onclick=${toggle}>
        <td>
          <div style="font-weight:600;color:#0f172a;">
            <span style="display:inline-block;width:12px;color:#64748b;font-size:0.7rem;">${isOpen ? "▾" : "▸"}</span>
            ${d.first_author}
          </div>
          <div class="mono" style="color:#64748b;padding-left:12px;">
            ${d.pmid ? d.pmid : "Preprint"}
          </div>
        </td>
        <td class="num-col">${d.year}</td>
        <td>${d.cohorts_display}</td>
        <td class="center-col">
          ${d.overlap_count > 0
            ? htl.html`<span class="pg-badge overlap-yes">${d.overlap_compact}</span>`
            : htl.html`<span class="overlap-none">None</span>`}
        </td>
        <td class="mono center-col"><strong>${d.pop_super}</strong></td>
        <td class="center-col">${d.sex}</td>
        <td class="num-col"><strong>${fmtInt(d.n_samples)}</strong></td>
        <td>${d.sample_matrix}</td>
        <td class="center-col">
          <span class="pg-badge ${platBadgeClass(d.platform_category)}">${d.platform_category}</span>
          <div style="font-size:0.71rem;color:#64748b;margin-top:1px;">${d.platform_version}</div>
        </td>
        <td class="num-col">${fmtInt(d.n_assays)}</td>
        <td class="center-col"><span class="pg-badge ${dataBadgeClass(d.data_label)}">${d.data_label}</span></td>
      </tr>`);

      if (isOpen) {
        trs.push(htl.html`<tr class="detail-row">
          <td colspan="11">${renderExpandedDetail(d, { isLookup: false })}</td>
        </tr>`);
      }
    }

    if (trs.length === 0) {
      trs.push(htl.html`<tr><td colspan="11" style="text-align:center;padding:1.5rem;color:#64748b;">No studies match the current column filters.</td></tr>`);
    }
    tbody.replaceChildren(...trs);
  }

  renderRows();

  const cs = catSummary;
  const panel1Plot = Plot.plot({
    width: 640,
    height: 285,
    marginLeft: 44,
    marginRight: 16,
    marginBottom: 38,
    style: { background: "transparent", fontSize: "11.5px", width: "100%" },
    x: {
      label: "Year",
      domain: cs.yearSeq,
      tickFormat: d => (d % 2 === 0 ? String(d) : "")
    },
    y: {
      label: "Studies (Published + Preprint)",
      grid: true
    },
    color: {
      legend: true,
      domain: cs.barCategories,
      range: ["#15803d", "#4ade80", "#334155", "#94a3b8"]
    },
    marks: [
      Plot.barY(cs.barData, {
        x: "year",
        y: "count",
        fill: "category",
        tip: true,
        title: d => `${d.year} · ${d.category}: ${d.count}\nTotal active studies in ${d.year}: ${d.yearTotal} (${d.yearOpenGw} open genome-wide)`
      }),
      Plot.ruleY([0])
    ]
  });

  const seriesDomain = ["Unique cohorts", "EUR", "MULTI", "AFR", "EAS", "CSA", "AMR", "MID"];
  const seriesColors = ["#0f172a", "#2563eb", "#7c3aed", "#d97706", "#0d9488", "#db2777", "#dc2626", "#64748b"];
  const cohortSeries = cs.cumLines.filter(d => d.isCohort);
  const popSeries = cs.cumLines.filter(d => !d.isCohort);

  const panel2Plot = Plot.plot({
    width: 640,
    height: 285,
    marginLeft: 48,
    marginRight: 18,
    marginBottom: 38,
    style: { background: "transparent", fontSize: "11.5px", width: "100%" },
    x: {
      label: "Year",
      tickFormat: d => String(d),
      ticks: cs.yearSeq.filter(y => y % 2 === 0)
    },
    y: {
      label: "Cumulative Count",
      grid: true
    },
    color: {
      legend: true,
      domain: seriesDomain,
      range: seriesColors
    },
    marks: [
      Plot.lineY(popSeries, {
        x: "year",
        y: "count",
        stroke: "series",
        strokeWidth: 2
      }),
      Plot.lineY(cohortSeries, {
        x: "year",
        y: "count",
        stroke: "series",
        strokeWidth: 2.6,
        strokeDasharray: "5,3"
      }),
      Plot.dot(cs.cumLines, {
        x: "year",
        y: "count",
        fill: "series",
        r: d => d.isCohort ? 3 : 2.2,
        tip: true,
        title: d => `${d.series} (${d.year})\nCumulative: ${d.count.toLocaleString()}`
      }),
      Plot.ruleY([0])
    ]
  });

  return htl.html`<div class="pg-shell">
    <div class="kpi-grid-6">
      <div class="kpi-card">
        <div class="kpi-label">LAST UPDATED</div>
        <div class="kpi-value" style="font-size:1.18rem;">${meta.last_updated}</div>
        <div class="kpi-sub">Version <span class="mono">${meta.current_version}</span> · ${cs.minYear}–${cs.maxYear}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="kpi-card">
        <div class="kpi-label">STUDIES</div>
        <div class="kpi-value">${cs.nStudies.toLocaleString()}</div>
        <div class="kpi-sub">${cs.nPublished} published · ${cs.nPreprints} preprints</div>
      </div>
      <div class="kpi-card">
        <div class="kpi-label">UNIQUE COHORTS</div>
        <div class="kpi-value">${cs.nCohorts.toLocaleString()}</div>
        <div class="kpi-sub">Across ${cs.nStrata.toLocaleString()} GWAS records</div>
      </div>
      <div class="kpi-card">
        <div class="kpi-label">UNIQUE PROTEINS</div>
        <div class="kpi-value">${cs.nProteins.toLocaleString()}</div>
        <div class="kpi-sub">${cs.nAssayRecords.toLocaleString()} assay records</div>
      </div>
      <div class="kpi-card">
        <div class="kpi-label">GENOME-WIDE DATA</div>
        <div class="kpi-value">${cs.nGw} <span style="font-size:0.88rem;font-weight:500;color:#64748b;">/ ${cs.nStrata}</span> <span class="pg-badge data-gw" style="vertical-align:middle;margin-left:2px;">${cs.nGwOpen} open</span></div>
        <div class="kpi-sub">${cs.nTopHits} top-hits · ${cs.nCis} cis · ${cs.nUnavail} unavail. (of ${cs.nRemaining})</div>
      </div>
      <div class="kpi-card">
        <div class="kpi-label">RECORDS BY PLATFORM</div>
        <div class="kpi-mini-grid">
          ${cs.platCounts.map(p => htl.html`<div class="kpi-mini-item" title="${p.full}: ${p.count} records">
            <span>${p.label}</span>
            <strong class="mono">${p.count}</strong>
          </div>`)}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="table-toolbar">
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.75rem;flex-wrap:wrap;">
        ${countSpan}
        ${clearBtn}
      </div>
      <div class="page-controls">
        <span>Rows:</span>
        ${pageSizeSelect}
        ${prevBtn}
        ${pageInfoSpan}
        ${nextBtn}
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="cat-table-wrap">
      <table class="cat-table">
        <thead>
          <tr class="sort-row">${sortHeaders}</tr>
          ${filterRow}
        </thead>
        ${tbody}
      </table>
    </div>

    <div class="bottom-download-bar">
      <a class="btn-pill btn-pill-primary" href="data/proteomic_gwas_catalogue_full.tsv" download>⬇ Download Full Table (.tsv)</a>
    </div>

    <div class="fig-grid-2col">
      <div class="panel-card" style="margin-bottom:0;">
        <div class="panel-title">
          <span>Annual Protein GWAS Publications &amp; Open Genome-Wide Availability</span>
        </div>
        ${panel1Plot}
      </div>
      <div class="panel-card" style="margin-bottom:0;">
        <div class="panel-title">
          <span>Cumulative Unique Cohorts &amp; Population Records Over Time</span>
        </div>
        ${panel2Plot}
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}
```
